name: F is for Family
description: Follow the Murphy family back to the 1970s, when kids roamed wild, beer flowed freely and nothing came between a man and his TV.

credits_cast.character: Maureen Murphy / Bridget Fitzsimmons / Phillip Bonfiglio (voice)
credits_cast.name: Debi Derryberry

credits_cast.character: Vivian Saunders / Lex / Ginny Throater / Nana Rose (voice)
credits_cast.name: Mo Collins

videos.title: The Bleedin' in Sweden
videos.overview: Desperate to keep his buddies from watching the fight at a neighbor's house, Frank promises an epic big-screen experience. But now he has to deliver.

videos.title: Saturday Bloody Saturday
videos.overview: Frank's attempt to teach Kevin a lesson about respect yields unintended results.  Maureen makes babysitting a nightmare for Bill.  Sue finds out selling Plast-a-Ware isn't as fulfilling as she'd like.

videos.title: The Trough
videos.overview: Frank makes a powerful friend at a football game and his move into management stirs up trouble with his old work pals.

videos.title: 'F' is for Halloween
videos.overview: Halloween is all tricks and no treats as Frank secretly torpedoes Sue's shot at a real job and a bully leaves Bill afraid to don his costume.

videos.title: Bill Murphy's Day Off
videos.overview: Bill's surprise attack on the neighborhood bully backfires in a big way. Frank has to swallow his pride to make good on a promise to Kevin.

videos.title: O Holy Moly Night
videos.overview: Christmas Eve turns chaotic as Frank's deal to avoid a strike hits a last-minute snag and Bill's first stint as an altar boy leads to trouble.

videos.title: Heavy Sledding
videos.overview: As Frank stews over his lost job, Sue tries to lighten the mood with a family sledding trip. But the outing brings on more headaches.

videos.title: A Girl Named Sue
videos.overview: Frank's big meeting doesn't play out quite like expected. Fed up with plasticware parties, Sue begins to fantastize about a change.

videos.title: The Liar's Club
videos.overview: Sue discovers a major downside of office life, Frank sucks it up for a trip to the unemployment line, and Kevin finally gets a space of his own.

videos.title: Night Shift
videos.overview: As Frank scrambles to prove himself at a new job, Kevin and his band plot to get their song on the radio. Sue has a Plast-a-Ware brainstorm.

videos.title: Breaking Bill
videos.overview: Kevin's dreams of rock stardom stir up trouble at home. A setback the day before hockey tryouts pushes Bill over the edge. Sue gives her big pitch.

videos.title: This Is Not Good
videos.overview: Frank's job takes him back to the airport, with awkward results. Kevin prepares for his date with "haircut girl". Bill revels in his new outlaw ways.

videos.title: Fight Night
videos.overview: Sue meets with the queen of Plast-a-Ware and plans a romantic night out with Frank. But a call from Maureen's school triggers a family meltdown.

videos.title: F Is for Fixing It
videos.overview: As Sue and Frank try to hash things out, Kevin is wracked with guilt over the incident at Vic's. Bill comes face to face with his old nemesis.

videos.title: Pray Away
videos.overview: A couple's retreat leads to a moment of truth for Frank and Sue. Bill and Phillip hatch a plan to deal with Jimmy. Suprises abound at Vic's party.

videos.title: Landing the Plane
videos.overview: Sue gears up for her big moment at the shareholders' meeting, while Frank and friends lay a trap for Scoop. But the day takes a dramatic turn.

videos.title: Are You Ready for the Summer?
videos.overview: The Murphys kick off summer with a trip to the town Memorial Day parade, where bottled-up frustrations and fears about the new baby boil over.

videos.title: Paul Lynde to Block
videos.overview: Sue's hopes of a romantic night with Frank at the drive-in are dashed when he brings the new neighbors along. Kevin's bandmates drop a bombshell.

videos.title: The Stinger
videos.overview: Sue dreams up a new invention, Kevin starts summer school, Bill suffers an awkward mishap at the pool, and a promotion stokes tensions at the airport.

videos.title: Mr. Murphy's Wild Ride
videos.overview: As the guys start work on the baby's room, Chet takes Frank on an unforgettable outing to the Air Force base. A jealous Phillip lashes out at Bill.

videos.title: Battle of the Sexes
videos.overview: While Sue hosts a soul-crushing focus group for the Forkoontula, Frank tries to keep Vic from bonding with Chet, and Bill sneaks out with Bridget.

videos.title: Punch Drunk
videos.overview: Frank can't wait to party with his new best bud on the Fourth of July, but rising tensions between Chet and Sue set off the wrong kind of fireworks.

videos.title: Summer Vacation
videos.overview: The family's summer trip to a lakeside cabin takes one vexing turn after another, and Kevin relives a traumatic childhood moment.

videos.title: It's In His Blood
videos.overview: An unwelcome surprise sends Frank's bromance with Chet into a tailspin. Maureen and Phillip train for their big day. Bill's breakup gets messy.

videos.title: Frank the Father
videos.overview: After bailing Kevin out, Frank tries a new parenting tactic. Meanwhile, Maureen's shot at TV fame hits a snag, and Bill weighs a big decision.

videos.title: Bill Murphy's Night Off
videos.overview: As the Murphys and their neighbors scour the city, Bill bounces from one harrowing ordeal to the next. Rosie's debate turns into a rescue mission.

videos.title: Father Confessor
videos.overview: A surprise visit from his estranged dad sends Frank off the deep end — and into the confession booth.

videos.title: Nothing Is Impossible
videos.overview: On back-to-school night, Frank stews over flashbacks to his fourth-grade play, while Sue fights to get Kevin into a special program for "dim lights."

videos.title: Bring Me a Tooth
videos.overview: Frank struggles to make good on his promises to Bill and Maureen. Vic gets a rude surprise on his first day back at the radio station.

videos.title: The 'B' Word
videos.overview: A lunch date sends Sue even deeper into a funk, Bill discovers a different side of his grandfather, and a desperate Vic offers to record Kevin's band.

videos.title: Just Breathe
videos.overview: While Frank and his dad tend to an emergency at the airport, Sue spends a maddening night at the hospital, and Bill takes a beating in the hockey rink.

videos.title: Come to Papa
videos.overview: Frank's pledge to be a better father and husband is tested by one calamity after the next, leading to an epic meltdown at Lamaze class.

videos.title: R Is For Rosie
videos.overview: Eager to make his mark as an alderman, Rosie heads to City Hall — only to find out the crooked mayor has his own plans for the Twelfth Ward.

videos.title: Murphy & Son
videos.overview: A string of good luck lifts the mood at the Murphy house. But a family outing to the fourth-grade play unleashes a fresh wave of chaos.

videos.title: Land Ho!
videos.overview: While Frank and the Mohican crew head to X-ray training in Cleveland, Vic gives Kevin and the band a total makeover for Kweezetoberfest.

videos.title: Baby, Baby, Baby
videos.overview: As Sue sets out on a star-crossed trek to the hospital, Frank races to catch a flight home — and vows to settle things with his dad once and for all.

videos.title: The Mahogany Fortress
videos.overview: At a family funeral, Frank deals with bottled-up emotions, Maureen befriends an embalmer, and Bill discovers the last rites can wipe away any sin.

videos.title: The Rustvale Massacre
videos.overview: While Sue tries to broker a peace deal with her dad, Frank meets the new airline management, and Bill and Maureen get into mischief on a field trip.

videos.title: Blind Alley
videos.overview: Sue hits the bars to look for her brother. Bill spends his Saturdays in a "scared straight" program. Kevin gets clingy after learning about Alice's ex.

videos.title: Thank You So Much
videos.overview: On Thanksgiving, Sue stresses over her family's visit, Vic begs his neighbors for help soothing the baby, and Bob's big dream suffers a setback.

videos.title: The Searchers
videos.overview: When Frank ducks out of a family day to scour the city for Box 16, Sue goes to a party at Vic's house. Bill and friends enjoy the perks of police life.

videos.title: Screw Ups
videos.overview: Sue takes Maureen to church to cure her obsession with the occult, Frank gives Bill an overdue sex talk, and Kevin pours his heart out to Smokey.

videos.title: A Very Merry F***ing Christmas
videos.overview: Inspired by his dad's words, Frank throws himself into a project at work. Sue starts a new business. The mayor takes his feud with Rosie too far.

videos.title: Bye Bye, Frankie
videos.overview: As the town flocks to the airport for the big Christmas Eve show, Frank scrambles to keep the event on track, and Rosie plots to expose the mayor.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 4 nominations total
